name: labs/7jameslondon__magscope
title: MagScope focus motor (magscope.PythonMicroscopeFocusMotor)
intro: MagScope focus motor (magscope.PythonMicroscopeFocusMotor), adapted from 7jameslondon/magscope. It reads `current_z`, `is_moving`, `lower_limit` and `upper_limit`; sets `target_z`; runs `focus`. `focus`: move the focus axis to a target Z position or run an autofocus search over a declared range, returning the achieved Z position and focus score. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
